reason: The initial registered run omitted the direct plug-in baseline that declares a mechanism reliable when the observed point-pass fraction reaches the reliability target. This amendment adds that baseline without changing the data-generating process, error levels, reliability targets, sample sizes, seeds, or repetitions.

added_baseline.name: Plug-in release fraction
added_baseline.release_label: Every observed requirement mean is at or below its tolerance.
added_baseline.mechanism_rule: The fraction of point-passing releases is at least the minimum reliability.

disclosure: The baseline was added after inspecting the first registered run. Its results are reported as an amended diagnostic, not as part of the original prospective comparison.
